(1) Synthesizer flags directly that the NVDA Q1 earnings catalyst the thesis cites within a 48h window does not exist in the 72h scheduled event calendar [SA-TECH-3] — the operative near-term binary is the Trump-China summit May 13 [SA-TECH-4, QR-2] with 26% residual cancellation probability creating asymmetric downside on export-control-sensitive names. (2) The 'sector momentum persists' key assumption holds at the sector level (14:2 advance/decline, AMD/MU/INTC/QCOM 52w highs per [SA-TECH-1]) but NVDA is diverging from peers — AVGO:NVDA 3.952σ [CR-53], MRVL:NVDA 4.60σ [CR-242], MU 20-day +77.56% vs NVDA +14.09% [AR-3]. The thesis support legs are weakening without a specific falsifier — at-risk, not invalidated.
position_assessments.action_rationale: Reduce 2 shares to cure the regime-transition breach (4.5% → 2.7%) while preserving residual exposure to the Trump-China summit binary, which is directionally constructive at the 74% scheduled probability and aligned with the [AR-5] rotation-into-growth signal. Full close would over-correct given the at-risk (not invalidated) status. Quantity sized to land below the 3.5% cap with buffer rather than grazing the limit.

The choice of partial-reduce over full-close reflects the at-risk classification — the residual catalyst leg (May 13 summit) is still live and directionally aligned with the dominant rotation frame.

position_assessments.status_rationale: Direct contradiction between entry thesis and current synthesizer frame. Thesis is 'long JPM on financials sector rotation'; [AR-5] identifies financials as the primary rotation LOSER in a moderate-confidence cross-sector signal anchored on 330+ correlation breakdowns, the inverted 2s/10s curve [AR-2], and structural NIM compression. [SA-FIN-2] records 13 declines vs 4 advances with near-universal bearish MACD. C:JPM at 6.30σ [CR-105] is the highest-magnitude correlation breakdown in the entire universe — extreme intra-financials divergence on the held name's pair partner. The 'sector momentum persists' key assumption is contradicted, not merely weakened. The one residual support is [SA-FIN-4]: a hot CPI print May 12 is constructive for money-center NIM, and JPM is money-center; this is a genuine asymmetric tail rather than rationalization. At-risk rather than invalidated because that tail exists with a binary in 41–48h; closing fully forecloses it.
position_assessments.action_rationale: Reduce 8 of 15 shares ($1,600 ≈ 1.6% of portfolio) to right-size against the thesis-component contradiction while preserving the hot-CPI tail leg. Holding full size on a directly-contradicted thesis would be sunk_cost_persistence — the entry premise (rotation INTO financials) is opposite to the dominant frame. Closing fully discards the [SA-FIN-4] tail; the partial reduction matches the at-risk-with-residual-support classification.
position_assessments.reduce_rationale: Sized to retain enough exposure to participate in a hot-CPI repricing (the lower-probability but JPM-supportive scenario) without carrying full thesis-contradicted size into the soft-print case, which [QR-1] flags as the larger and more disruptive repricing. Old size 3.0% → new size ~1.4%, halving the position to reflect halved thesis support.
position_assessments.cross_position_observations: [XLF→SPY 1-day lead-lag, CR-13] means financials deterioration historically leads broad-market moves by one session — the JPM reduction has cumulative-impact significance for the whole book ahead of the CPI binary, not just the financials sleeve.

position_assessments.status_rationale: Entry thesis is 'energy capex normalization.' [SA-ENERGY-1] documents the services-vs-E&P ordering as anomalous — SLB +4.78% and BKR +3.87% versus OXY −6.3%, APA −5.8%, DVN −2.4% — and identifies operator capex curtailment as one of three explanations consistent with the inversion (the others being direct Hormuz-operations pricing of services and probability-not-realization pricing of disruption). Capex curtailment is the direct opposite of capex normalization. XOM is not named-falsified — it is integrated rather than pure E&P — but the thesis component 'sector momentum persists in the direction of normalization' is challenged by the dominant intra-sector signal in this invocation. [SA-ENERGY-TC-1] further flags the 17.5% US-Iran nuclear deal probability by May 31 as a sharp services-premium-compression risk that would impact the broader energy thesis. At-risk per the strategist's borderline-toward-at-risk default on thesis-component contradiction without name-specific falsifier.
position_assessments.action_rationale: Reduce 8 of 20 shares ($880 ≈ 0.88% of portfolio) to acknowledge the contradicted-component classification without over-correcting on a thesis whose falsification is structural rather than name-specific. Hold-on-at-risk is disallowed by method discipline. Quantity is modest because the contradiction is at the thesis-component level not the position-specific level, and XOM as integrated is partially insulated from the pure-E&P-capex story.
position_assessments.reduce_rationale: Sized smaller than the JPM reduction because the JPM contradiction is direct-and-named (financials = rotation loser) while the XOM contradiction is structural-and-inferred (capex normalization vs. capex curtailment as one of three coexisting explanations). Old size 2.2% → new size ~1.3%.
